text: At the close of the project, what type of chip is decided for the remote control?
reference_answer: A regular chip. It is decided in ES2015c and remains in force in ES2015d, where it is reaffirmed unchanged.
author: gm
validation_notes: El segundo tramo de evidencia (ES2015d) no deja claro si reafirma la decisión de 'chip regular' o solo la menciona de pasada; confirma antes de dar la respuesta de referencia por buena.

text: Did the functional scope of the remote control change between the first and the second meeting? In what way and why?
reference_answer: Yes. In ES2015a it is decided that it will be a television remote control; in ES2015b it is narrowed to a single-function design, television only, excluding DVD and VCR. The reason given in the meeting is that including those controls would complicate the design and put it over budget.
